title: Two 1RB1RE siblings: no halt in 10<sup>16</sup> and 5·10<sup>11</sup> steps, and a phase table
text: 1RB1RE_1RC0RF_0LD---_1LE1LD_1RA0LB_0RE1RF: its accelerated engine reaches 1.02·10<sup>16</sup> steps without a halt in one scripted run from blank tape (16 cycle rules). 1RB1RE_1RC0RF_0LD---_1LE1LD_1RA0LB_0RE1LC: no halt in 5·10<sup>11</sup> plain steps; the run alternates phases that turn the left zone (100)^a into 5-cell words with phases that regrow it, and an irregular stretch of about 120,000 cells is touched only between phases. Neither sibling can use DeepMind's PR 93 engine: they leave the run of 1RB1RE_1RC0RF_0LD---_1LE1LD_1RA0LB_0RE0RF at step 370.
